Careers

Full Stack Developer Intern

At Fyno Digital, web development is best learned by building real projects and solving real problems. As a Full Stack Developer Intern, you will gain hands-on experience in creating responsive websites, understanding UI/UX implementation, and working on live client projects.

About Fyno

Fyno Digital is a growth-focused digital agency where strategy, branding, design, marketing, and execution come together to create meaningful business impact.

What You’ll Do



- Assist in building responsive website sections and pages.
- Learn how designs are converted into functional front-end layouts.
- Support bug fixes, content updates, and UI improvements.
- Work on HTML, CSS, and basic JavaScript tasks.
- Gain practical exposure to live client projects.

Who We’re Looking For



- A fresher interested in web development and modern websites.
- Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
- Eagerness to learn responsive design and practical workflow.
- Someone open to feedback and improvement.
- Passion for coding and building digital experiences.

Why Join Fyno ?



- Gain real hands-on development experience.
- Work on practical projects instead of dummy exercises.
- Learn with design and marketing teams around you.
- Build a portfolio with meaningful work.
- Develop industry-ready execution skills.
